findings.evidence: `mem_closure_iff_nhds_zero` (to_additive of `mathlib/Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Group/Neighborhood.lean:79`, `x ∈ closure s ↔ ∀ U ∈ 𝓝 1, ∃ y ∈ s, y / x ∈ U`) applied to `hφ b` yields `∃ y ∈ Set.range φ, y - b ∈ V ∩ -V`; the two-component conjunction that `choose a ha ha'` destructures exists only after simp, and is recorded nowhere in the file.
findings.fix: State it and then choose: `have happrox : ∀ b : B, ∃ x : A, φ x - b ∈ V ∧ b - φ x ∈ V := fun b ↦ by simpa using mem_closure_iff_nhds_zero.mp (hφ b) _ (Filter.inter_mem hV (neg_mem_nhds_zero B hV))` followed by `choose a ha ha' using happrox`.
findings.issue: `choose a ha ha' using fun b ↦ by simpa using ...` elaborates the `by` block with the goal still a metavariable, so the approximation fact is never stated; `ha` and `ha'` are whatever `simp` makes of `y - b ∈ V ∩ -V` (it must fire `Set.mem_neg` then `neg_sub` to land on `b - φ x ∈ V`). Lines 68 and 72 depend on that exact normal form, and a reader cannot tell which of `ha`/`ha'` gives which direction.

findings.evidence: `ContinuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds {t : Set Y} (h : ContinuousAt f x) (ht : t ∈ 𝓝 (f x)) : f ⁻¹' t ∈ 𝓝 x` at `mathlib/Mathlib/Topology/Continuous.lean:74` is exactly this statement; `exists_finset_subset_isOpen_span` (`TauCeti/RingTheory/Huber/OpenIdeal.lean:220`) takes `{V : Set A}` implicit, so nothing in the call site names `φ ⁻¹' V`.
findings.fix: Use the named lemma and fix the set explicitly: `obtain ⟨G, hGV, hGopen⟩ := exists_finset_subset_isOpen_span (V := φ ⁻¹' V) (hφc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (by rwa [map_zero]))`.
findings.issue: `exists_finset_subset_isOpen_span (hφc.tendsto' 0 0 (map_zero φ) hV)` applies a `Filter.Tendsto` as a function, giving `V ∈ Filter.map φ (𝓝 0)`; the implicit `V` of `exists_finset_subset_isOpen_span` is then determined only by unfolding `Filter.map` to reach `φ ⁻¹' V ∈ 𝓝 0`, so the type of `hGV` (used again at line 72) is undocumented defeq.

summary: Proofs are short and mostly clean, but the private helper's key approximation step is elaborated against a metavariable goal, so neither the statement it proves nor the direction of the resulting hypotheses is written anywhere, and the adjacent neighbourhood step pins an implicit argument only by unfolding `Filter.map`.
